Assignment 2 - Mohammed Faaris Khan

    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Accommodation
    Represents a generic tourism accommodation.
    AdventureTourPackage
    Represents an adventure tour package that extends the base TourPackage.
    AgroTourismVenture
    Represents an agro-tourism venture extending Business.
    App
    Main application class for the Tourism and Agriculture Inheritance Demonstration.
    Business
    Represents a generic business entity.
    Crop
    Represents a generic crop in the Agriculture domain.
    EcoFriendly
    Interface representing eco-friendly business practices.
    FarmLand
    Represents agricultural farm land that is both irrigable and insurable.
    FoodGrain
    Represents a food grain crop, extending Crop.
    Homestay
    Represents a homestay accommodation extending Accommodation.
    Hotel
    Represents a hotel accommodation extending Accommodation.
    Insurable
    Interface representing insurable agricultural property.
    Irrigable
    Interface representing irrigable agricultural land.
    OrganicFoodGrain
    Represents an organic food grain, the deepest class in the Multilevel Inheritance chain.
    Resort
    Represents a resort accommodation extending Accommodation.
    SustainableAgroTourism
    Represents a sustainable agro-tourism business.
    TourOperator
    Represents a tour operator business extending Business.
    TourPackage
    Represents a generic tour package in the Tourism domain.
